subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw expose a core shell-facing admin notification broadcast to all connected Control UI sessions, and if so what authorization, payload, targeting, and rate-limit contract should it use?
rationale: The code path is clear enough to implement, but the permanent API/security boundary and overlap with broader notification work need maintainer intent before automation should add a new admin broadcast surface.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded core notification contract
options.body: Define the admin-scoped Gateway RPC/event, CLI UX, Control UI behavior, payload limits, rate limits, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into the broader WebUI notification tracker
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20237 the product/design owner and keep this issue as linked input for shell/admin use cases.

options.title: Defer to plugin or external automation
options.body: Decline a new core command unless a missing plugin/Gateway extension API is identified and scoped separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded core notification contract
recommendation.body: Define the admin-scoped Gateway RPC/event, CLI UX, Control UI behavior, payload limits, rate limits, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows this person carrying the relevant Gateway, CLI, and UI notification-adjacent surfaces most recently.
